title: VanillaFih: Origins
description: A lightweight idiot-proof origins modpack optimized for multiplayer/smp usage.
body:
An easy to use, optimized, multiplayer vanilla plus modpack centered around origins and exploration. 

## VanillaFih: Origins

### About
  I made this modpack to play with my stupid chungus friends. I tried as hard as I could to make sure this pack can run on basically any PC and has as little initial set up as possible. Even the modded keybinds, texture packs, and video settings have been preconfigured to have no conflicts on startup and run smoothly. Feel free to change them as you please, but this is for those people who spend an hour in the options screen (lowkey me).

### Origins

  This modpack is balanced around vanilla, so origins have a great impact on your gameplay. A ton of origins haven't been added over the base ones so feel free to add your own custom datapacks and addons for this.

### World Generation

  A combination of [terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) and [tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) creates a lush and dynamic world that's fun to explore and build in. [Hookshots](https://modrinth.com/mod/hookshot) and [airships](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft) have been added to help traverse this terrain.

![terratonic mountains](https://i.imgur.com/rQWmoRh.jpeg)
![terratonic oceans](https://i.imgur.com/jvsRzCv.jpeg)
![terratonic mirage isles](https://i.imgur.com/OEqSvmW.jpeg)

  The nether has also been revitalized with [cinderscapes](https://modrinth.com/mod/cinderscapes) and [amplified nether](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amplified-nether)

### Dungeons and Exploration

  Several beautifully designed dungeons andstructures from [moog's](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnSetchell), [yung's](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG), and more are scattered around the world, with lootr so you don't have to fight over loot. World gen can be a little slow sometimes, but should NOT cause any lag. Airships and hookshots should also make traversing the extreme terrain easier.
  
### Bosses and Combat

  Tons of new bosses to fight from [BMD](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction), [ultris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultris), and [aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae), along with a remastered enderdragon fight! A ton of new ranged and melee weapons have also been added.

### Performance and QOL

  I have put in a TON of effort into making the game run smoothly while also looking as pretty as possible. There are also a lot of QOL changes like [graves](https://modrinth.com/mod/yigd), waystones, crafting changes, and backports that make the game less annoying and more fun. 

### Multiplayer

  [Simple radio](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-radio), [figura](https://modrinth.com/mod/figura), and a ton of other mods enhance the social aspect of gameplay! Simple voice chat does need [some setup](https://modrepo.de/minecraft/voicechat/wiki/server_setup), but it shouldnt be that bad I pawmise. You can find figura avatars over at their discord server.

### Building

  [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), [rechiseled](https://modrinth.com/mod/rechiseled), and several other building and decoration mods will take your builds and interiors to the next level and feel more homey and personal. 

### Food

  A psychotic amount of food has been added through [farmer's delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-fabric) and some hand selected addons for it. [Spice of frabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/spice-of-fabric) has been configured to reward you with more hp (up to 40) for cooking a diverse and balanced diet, while not punishing players who can't be asked.
  
### A Lil Magic

  A tiny bit of magic from [enchanted: witchcraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchanted-witchcraft) and [extra alchemy](https://modrinth.com/mod/extraalchemy/) for the witches out there :3
